evals.prompt: Replay the provider's webhook stream, including a duplicated event, a retry under a new event id and a duplicated refund, into a fresh test store.
evals.expected_output: Exit 0; 2 captures, 2 fulfillments, 1 refund, inventory 10 to 8; a second replay changes nothing.
expectations: outcomes has duplicate-event, duplicate-order and duplicate-refund

evals.prompt: Process a live-mode event, an event whose amount was changed after signing, and another tenant's event.
evals.expected_output: Exit 1; all three refused; the store holds no events or captures.

evals.prompt: Two different orders race for the last founder-edition unit.
evals.expected_output: Exit 1; one fulfilled, one held for a human; inventory 0, never negative; reconcile lists the hold.
expectations: one fulfilled and one needs-human outcome
